disposition_reason: A systematic review summarizing published feeding studies and contamination reports for mycotoxins and heavy metals in insects; all numbers are quoted from other papers.

study.design: systematic review (SciFinder, PubMed, to 26 June 2019) of mycotoxin and heavy-metal contamination of insects for food and feed

controls.control: Starvation (gut-emptying) period before harvest (recommendation from reviewed studies)
controls.outcome: Gut content contributes relevantly to total contaminant body burden; review recommends a starving period before harvest (no primary numbers)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU maximum contents for feed materials (A) and complete feed (B), Directive 2002/32/EC, mg/kg at 12% moisture
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Cd A 2 / B 0.5; Pb A 10 / B 5; As A 2 / B 2; Hg A 0.1 / B 0.1

unresolved: Systematic review quoting other studies; no primary measurements, so no findings.
